svg.title: The two footprint substitutions
svg.desc: Left: an AGV under a parked tray is checked against the tray's legs, so it fits. Right: a loaded tray beside a parked AGV is checked with the tray footprint, not the payload's.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Moving AGV, parked tray: checked against TRAY_LEGS

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The AGV body is lower than the tray deck, so only the legs can

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: stop it. With the full TRAY rectangle no AGV could ever drive

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: under a tray to lift it.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Moving PAYLOAD or AGV, parked AGV: checked as a TRAY

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: A car overhangs its tray but sits above an AGV's height, so the tray

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: frame is what an AGV body can hit. The check uses the TRAY rectangle

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: for a passing payload; the collision table has the payload entry too.
